question: How do motorist and cyclist deaths compare year by year in NYC, 2013 to 2025?
answer: Motorist deaths exceeded cyclist deaths every year from 2013 to 2025—ranging from 72 to 139 motorist deaths annually, versus 10 to 31 cyclist deaths. Motorist deaths peaked in 2020 (139); cyclist deaths peaked at 31 in 2019 and 2023.
